# Thieme-Connect

> > Thieme-Connect is a digital publishing platform providing access to medical and scientific content with OAI-PMH metadata harvesting capabilities.

Thieme-Connect serves as the online portal for Thieme's medical and scientific publications, offering standardized metadata access through the Open Archives Initiative Protocol for Metadata Harvesting (OAI-PMH). This enables libraries, repositories, and research institutions to programmatically harvest and integrate Thieme's scholarly content metadata into their systems.

## Key Topics

- OAI-PMH (Open Archives Initiative Protocol for Metadata Harvesting)
- Metadata harvesting
- OAI provider
- API endpoints
- Thieme-Connect platform
- Digital publishing
- Medical and scientific content
- Scholarly metadata
- Repository integration
- Library systems

## API & Integration

- [OAI Provider](https://www.thieme-connect.de/oai/): OAI-PMH metadata harvesting API endpoint for Thieme-Connect content
